info.title: Micelio site API
info.description: The HTTP routes every Micelio site serves: 39 paths and 41 operations, from `server/api` and `server/routes`. Generated from `server/openapi/` and the zod schemas of `server/schemas/`; do not edit by hand. Errors under `/api` are problem details (RFC 9457). Response bodies with a schema are in `components.schemas`; the others are described by status and media type, naming their TypeScript type in `app/interfaces`.

servers.description: Your site. The API is served from the same origin as the pages.

get.summary: Security contact
get.description: The security contact of the site (RFC 9116): `Contact` from the site settings, `Expires` 180 days after the render, `Preferred-Languages` and `Canonical`. Answers `notFound` with an empty body when the settings have no valid contact, and never invents one.

200.description: Plain text in the `security.txt` format. Cache-Control: `public, max-age=3600`.

404.description:
Not Found. The `code` is one of:
- `notFound`: The body is empty, not a problem document: a client of `security.txt` expects a plain 404.

get.summary: WebFinger lookup of the site account
get.description: WebFinger (RFC 7033) on the site domain, so the handle `@<user>@<site host>` resolves without a proxy rule: the CMS answer for `resource`, with its status, body and `Content-Type`. Only `resource` is sent to the CMS (the first one, when repeated), with no visitor header, cookie or credential. A `Content-Type` other than JRD, JSON or plain text goes out as `application/octet-stream`. Answers `notFound` with an empty body when the fediverse module is off. A CMS that takes more than 5 seconds answers an empty `504`.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: The account to look up, such as `acct:blog@example.com`; at most 1024 characters.

200.description: The JSON Resource Descriptor of the account, with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Cache-Control: `public, max-age=300`.

400.description:
Bad Request. The `code` is one of:
- `invalidRequest`: The CMS answer for a missing `resource`, or an empty body for one longer than 1024 characters.

404.description:
Not Found. The `code` is one of:
- `notFound`: The fediverse module is off (empty body), or the CMS knows no such account (its body). Not a problem document: a WebFinger client expects the CMS answer.

429.description:
Too Many Requests. The `code` is one of:
- `tooManyRequests`: An empty body with `Retry-After`: 30 lookups a minute per visitor, 300 for the site; or the CMS's own 429, passed on with its `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, when the limit says.

502.description:
Bad Gateway. The `code` is one of:
- `upstreamUnavailable`: An empty body: the CMS could not be reached, redirected, or sent more than 64 KiB. Any other CMS error passes through with its status and body.

get.summary: Open a draft in the admin's iframe with a preview token
get.description: The CMS gives the admin page a one-use token (`docs/operate/preview.md`); the frame opens this route with it. The frontend exchanges the token for a grant, keeps the grant in the `__Host-micelio_preview` cookie (`HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=None`, `Partitioned`) and redirects to the draft route without the token. A token that is used, expired, altered or of another site, a grant for another admin origin, and a site with `NUXT_PREVIEW_ADMIN_ORIGIN` unset all answer the same 404 page. Answers `private, no-store`.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The preview token.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode of the draft route: `dynamic` (default) or `static`, which leaves every island on its static alternative.

303.description: The draft route of the document the grant names, without the token.

Not Found. The `code` is one of:

429.description:
Too Many Requests. The `code` is one of:
- `tooManyRequests`: Too many requests. Wait for the time in the Retry-After header, if present, before trying again.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, when the limit says.

get.summary: A file of the active theme
get.description: A stylesheet, font, image or `runtime.json` of a compiled theme, from the bytes verified when it was loaded. `digest` is the 64 hex digits of the entry the site serves; any other digest, and any file the entry does not list, answers the same empty `notFound`. Brotli or gzip is sent when the request accepts it, with `Vary: Accept-Encoding`. The file is immutable (the digest changes with the content), `nosniff` and sandboxed by the static CSP.

parameters.name: digest
parameters.description: The digest of a theme entry the site serves.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: A file of the entry, such as `theme.css` or `fonts/archivo.woff2`.

200.description: The file, with its own content type (`text/css`, `application/json`, `font/woff2`, an image type). Cache-Control: `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`.

404.description:
Not Found. The `code` is one of:
- `notFound`: The resource does not exist.

get.summary: Get the weight of a draft
get.description: The weight of the draft as a visitor would download it, measured on the rendered page and never estimated: the draft is rendered in the requested mode and once more without each of its blocks, so a block's share is the difference. KB are 1024 bytes as this server sends them (HTML, the scripts, stylesheets and fonts it declares, and the images not marked `loading="lazy"`). `onDemandKb` is the script its islands load only once one is used, apart from `totalKb`. Authorised by a preview grant of ADR 0019, which shows only the document it names: the editor's, in the `__Host-micelio_preview` cookie, or the CMS's own system grant, in the `X-Micelio-Preview-Grant` header, which works with the preview off, is used once and names one version of the draft. Anyone else gets `notFound`, as does a content type that is not an article or a page. Kept 5 minutes per version of the draft. Answers `private, no-store`.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: The content type of the document: `api::article.article` or `api::page.page`, URL-encoded as the client sees fit.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: The document id the grant names.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: The language of the draft: `en` or `es`. Optional.

parameters.name: X-Micelio-Preview-Grant
parameters.description: The system grant the CMS mints to measure a draft at publish (at most 256 characters). Optional: without it the editor's grant cookie is read. It is never sent to a browser.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The mode to render in: `dynamic` (default) or `static`, which leaves every island on its static alternative, as the preview does.

200.description: The weight report of the draft in the requested mode.
